test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the agenda behind the Government of India's flagship programme ‘Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana’?

options.text: To provide affordable housing to all.
To provide a minimum monthly pension of ₹1000 or ₹2000
Assured pension on a guaranteed return of 8% after making a minimum initial investment for Senior Citizen
To provide a life cover of ₹200,000 against a premium of ₹330 per annum.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Assured pension on a guaranteed return of 8% after making a minimum initial investment for Senior Citizen**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana (PMVVY)** is a pension scheme launched by the Government of India for senior citizens aged 60 years and above.
 
• It aims to provide an assured return of 8% per annum payable monthly for a period of 10 years.
 
• Under the scheme, the pensioner can opt for a monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, or yearly pension.
 
• The scheme is managed by the **Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC)**.
 
• The maximum investment limit is ₹15 lakh per senior citizen.
 
• After the policy term of 10 years, the purchase price along with the final pension installment is returned to the policyholder.
 
• In case of the pensioner's death during the policy term of 10 years, the purchase price is returned to the beneficiary.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The scheme was launched by the Government on **4th May 2017** and was available for subscription till **31st March 2020**.
 
• However, the scheme has been extended and is available for investment till **31st March 2023**.
 
• The scheme also provides a loan facility after the completion of 3 policy years, up to a maximum of 75% of the purchase price.
 
• The interest on the loan shall be recovered from the pension installments, and the loan amount shall be recovered from the claim proceeds.
 
• The scheme is exempt from the Goods and Services Tax (GST).
